Nobody warned me that the hardest part of shipping an agent would be the expense reports.

Every Monday it files a tidy list of the tools it tried, the ones it kept, and the twelve dollars it spent on a database it never used.

The finance team loves it. It is the only employee whose receipts always add up.

I have started reading its notes before my own calendar.
